Visa Students coming from EU countries do not need visa.  
Other international students can get information about visa application procedure at the 
Czech Embassies or C onsulates in their home countries or they can consult the 
website of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Czech Republic and the website of the 
Ministry of the Interior. 
 
If you need a visa, ask the Czech Embassy/Consulate in your home country about the 
procedure. Remember that you need documents from UPCE. Visa applications are 
processed usually within 60 days. It is not possible to apply for a visa from the Czech 
Republic. 
UPCE issues the following documents: 
• Acceptance letter in Czech and English – after the final LA is approved and 
submitted. 
• Accommodation agreement – after the deposit is paid. 
The documents are sent to the International Office of the sending institution.
